beats.text: Windows Solitaire was written by an intern, for himself.
beats.note: Wes Cherry made it in his own time in summer 1988, for Windows 2.1.

beats.text: He had been playing a Mac version instead of studying.
beats.note: Cherry says he wanted a Windows version for himself.

beats.name: Susan Kare
beats.role: Designed the card deck. Solitaire shipped in Windows 3.0, released 22 May 1990.

beats.note: Cherry says he was supplied with an IBM XT to fix bugs and was perfectly fine with that.

beats.context: Monthly players across 200 markets at the 30th anniversary in 2020, according to Engadget.

beats.text: A student's side project became one of the most played games ever.

beats.line: Gaming history hides in the bundled apps.
